## Trial `boot-kernel-parameter-ubuntu16__NA6X97F`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor correctly configured GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=\"audit=1\" in /etc/default/grub (bypassing the cloudimg drop-in that only sets GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT), regenerated grub.cfg with update-grub, and confirmed audit=1 in all boot menu entries. It then performed the mandatory node restart, directly observing a healthy pre-restart baseline, an acknowledged reboot, a bounded disruption (SSH refused), restored connectivity, a changed boot_id, and post-restart /proc/cmdline showing audit=1 — a full and coherent demonstration of both persistence and safe restart recovery. No unnecessary mutations were introduced.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.950 | 9/2 |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **R1 — Satisfied:** Kernel boots with audit=1 on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline /proc/cmdline (cmd-f11cce5425a649e8) showed no audit=1. Executor set GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" in /etc/default/grub (cmd-606ad47c73f74d06), correctly noting the cloudimg drop-in only overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT so this survives. After a genuine reboot (boot_id changed from 9094f607... to bc0b1a26..., cmd-5b2ffce98c2d40b7, cross-checked by global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity), /proc/cmdline on the newly booted kernel shows audit=1 present, directly confirming the running kernel booted with the parameter.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-f11cce5425a649e8`, `cmd-606ad47c73f74d06`, `cmd-5b2ffce98c2d40b7`, `global:before_prepare:node1:boot-identity`, `global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity`
- **R2 — Satisfied:** Setting persists across reboots (not just a one-time boot flag)
  - **Why:** The change was made to the persistent config file /etc/default/grub rather than a one-time bootloader edit, and update-grub was run to regenerate /boot/grub/grub.cfg (cmd-1e3941befcfb47d3), with audit=1 confirmed present in all three menu entries: normal, advanced, and recovery (cmd-f89be5c9e33e49cf). The demonstrated reboot (before/after boot_id change, cmd-e2ee710faace46e7 and cmd-5b2ffce98c2d40b7) confirms at least one full reboot cycle picked up the change from the regenerated grub.cfg, the standard mechanism for reboot persistence in GRUB-based systems.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-1e3941befcfb47d3`, `cmd-f89be5c9e33e49cf`, `cmd-e2ee710faace46e7`, `cmd-5b2ffce98c2d40b7`
- **R3 — Satisfied:** Node1 restart transition demonstrated with healthy pre/post state (provider-wide restart protocol)
  - **Why:** Pre-restart: boot_id 9094f607..., systemd is-system-running=running (cmd-e2ee710faace46e7). Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-12c4efc3fdcc4499, 'ack-reboot-issued'). Node unavailability directly observed via SSH connection refused (cmd-c3f02a29b6004a3b, rc=255), followed by restored connectivity (cmd-0c532fd411ee4c28). Post-restart: different boot_id bc0b1a26..., fresh uptime, systemd is-system-running=running, and /proc/cmdline with audit=1 (cmd-5b2ffce98c2d40b7). This is a full, coherent bounded-disruption-and-recovery transition, cross-checked by the fixed lifecycle boot-identity snapshots.

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **1.000**. All state-changing executor commands map directly to the task: the sed edit to /etc/default/grub (cmd-606ad47c73f74d06) implements the required kernel parameter, update-grub (cmd-1e3941befcfb47d3) regenerates the bootloader config as a necessary consequence, and the reboot (cmd-12c4efc3fdcc4499) is both the mandatory restart-evidence action and the mechanism for demonstrating persistence. No unnecessary mutations, troubleshooting experiments, or abandoned state were found. The only diffs between after_prepare and after_executor snapshots are the boot_id itself and boot-scoped systemd-private temp directories under /tmp, expected side effects of a legitimate reboot, not residue. Failed-services and listening-sockets remained empty, and package-health remained consistent (dpkg) across the change.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-606ad47c73f74d06`, `cmd-1e3941befcfb47d3`, `cmd-12c4efc3fdcc4499`, `global:after_executor:node1:temporary-files`, `global:after_executor:node1:failed-services`, `global:after_executor:node1:package-health`
